arguments.sql: SELECT c.mcc, c.description, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions t JOIN merchants m ON t.merchant_id = m.id JOIN mcc_codes c ON m.mcc = c.mcc WHERE c.description = 'Passenger Railways' GROUP BY c.mcc, c.description ORDER BY c.mcc, c.description
arguments.explanation: Counts transactions for each MCC code whose description is 'Passenger Railways', one row per code.
assumptions: Matched the description exactly as 'Passenger Railways' (case-sensitive).
Counted all transactions, labelled or unlabelled, and included negative-amount transactions.
Used the merchant's MCC via transactions.merchant_id -> merchants.mcc -> mcc_codes.
